nodes.description: uint256 public maxHippos; maximum total supply of minted hippos, set in constructor.
uint constant public MAX_PURCHASE = 16; per-transaction mint cap used by presaleMint and mintHippo.
uint constant public MAX_PRESALE = 444; presale supply cap used by presaleMint.
bool public saleIsActive; public sale switch toggled by flipSaleState and read by mintHippo.
bool public preSaleIsActive; presale switch toggled by flipPreSaleState and read by presaleMint.
uint256 public constant PRICE = 60000000000000000; wei price per hippo used for msg.value checks.
string public provenance; provenance hash written by setProvenanceHash.
string private baseURI; token metadata base set by setBaseURI and read by _baseURI.
uint256 public startingIndex; pseudo-random reveal offset set in setStartingIndex.
uint256 public startingIndexBlock; block number captured for the starting index randomness.
uint256 public REVEAL_TIMESTAMP; reveal deadline timestamp set in constructor and setRevealTimestamp.
Caller-controlled address used as minter/owner/receiver and for onlyOwner checks.
Miner-influenced timestamp compared against REVEAL_TIMESTAMP in trySetStartingIndexBlock.
payable(msg.sender).transfer(balance); external value transfer of the whole contract balance.
External call to IERC721Receiver(to).onERC721Received triggered by _safeMint after state changes.
startingIndex derived from blockhash(startingIndexBlock) % maxHippos: weak/malleable randomness.
constructor(string name, string symbol, uint256 maxSupply, uint256 saleStart) sets maxHippos and REVEAL_TIMESTAMP = saleStart + 86400.
onlyOwner setter that overwrites REVEAL_TIMESTAMP with an arbitrary value.
onlyOwner setter that writes the provenance string.
onlyOwner setter that writes baseURI.
onlyOwner toggle of saleIsActive.
onlyOwner toggle of preSaleIsActive.
onlyOwner reserve mint: loops _safeMint(msg.sender, supply + i) with no supply bound check.
private helper setting startingIndexBlock from block.number when supply is exhausted or REVEAL_TIMESTAMP passed (timestamp dependence).
payable presale mint verifying preSaleIsActive, MAX_PURCHASE, MAX_PRESALE and msg.value == numberOfHippos*PRICE, then loops _safeMint.
payable public sale mint verifying saleIsActive, MAX_PURCHASE, maxHippos and msg.value, then loops _safeMint and calls trySetStartingIndexBlock.
onlyOwner withdrawal transferring the full contract balance to msg.sender.
permissionless reveal: computes startingIndex from blockhash of startingIndexBlock modulo maxHippos with fallback and zero-avoidance.
onlyOwner fallback that forces startingIndexBlock = block.number if not yet set.
internal view override returning the stored baseURI.
Caller-supplied count for reserveHippos, used as loop bound with no upper limit.
local uint supply = totalSupply() used as the first reserve token id.
unchecked loop counter of reserveHippos.
Presale mint quantity validated against MAX_PURCHASE, MAX_PRESALE and msg.value.
loop counter of presaleMint used as the _safeMint iteration variable.
Public sale mint quantity validated against MAX_PURCHASE, maxHippos and msg.value.
loop counter of mintHippo used as the _safeMint iteration variable.
Owner-supplied new value written into REVEAL_TIMESTAMP.
Owner-supplied provenance string written into provenance.
Owner-supplied URI string written into baseURI.
local uint balance = address(this).balance used as the transfer amount.
ERC721 token name passed to the ERC721 constructor.
ERC721 token symbol passed to the ERC721 constructor.
Deployer-supplied supply cap written into maxHippos.
Deployer-supplied sale start used to derive REVEAL_TIMESTAMP = saleStart + 86400.
